title: Asteroid Drift
description: First-person asteroid dodger/shooter: fly forward through a tumbling field of rocks, steer with mouse or arrows, blast asteroids with spacebar lasers, and survive as long as you can.
prompt: A first-person asteroid dodger/shooter: fly forward through a field of tumbling rocks, steer with the mouse or arrow keys, score climbs the longer you survive, and you get a clear game-over with a restart key. Pressing space or hitting spacebar shoots lasers, when a laser hits a asteroid it explodes.
